hagar.title: File:Hagar (from Mothers of the Bible), by Henry Ossawa Tanner.jpg
hagar.description:
Hagar (from Mothers of the Bible), by Henry Ossawa Tanner. Published October 1902 in the Ladies' Home Journal, page 13.
And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar. . . .and sent her away; and she departed and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba--GENESIS XXI, 14.

Tanner painted the scene in which Hagar is banished.
hagar.note: Historical art illustrates the story. It does not establish actual appearance.
